title: 2115 Prairie's south end drops to a railed roof, matching both photographs
items: The Armour house's tall slate mansard now ends at its south tower. The narrow end of the front beyond it has a flat roof at the cornice with a low stone balustrade, as the winter photograph and the Tribune's 1928 picture both show.
With that, the house matches both of its photographs, and its picture check is signed off.
